```artifact
## UML Testing Profile (UTP)

**Test Suite Name:** U31_10_Lab_Management

**Test Suite Description:** This suite tests the functionalities of lab management features, including report submission, patient access to prescriptions, and archiving of patient profiles.

**Test Suite Scope:**
- Lab In-charge can view open lab requests and update their status.
- Patient can view their prescription and print the invoice.
- Quarterly, patient profiles inactive for 3 years are archived.
- Consultation requests older than 3 years are archived.

**Test Suite Preconditions:**
- User is logged in as Lab In-charge or Patient.

**Test Suite Postconditions:**
- Lab reports are submitted successfully.
- Patient can view their prescription.
- Inactive patient profiles are archived.

**Test Cases:**

| ID | Title | Requirement ID | Kind | Preconditions | Inputs | Steps | Expected |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| TC-001 | Lab In-charge can view open lab requests | Req-10 | Positive | Lab In-charge is logged in. | None | Lab In-charge navigates to the open lab requests page. | Lab requests are displayed with details. |
| TC-002 | Lab In-charge can update lab request status | Req-10 | Positive | Lab In-charge is logged in. | Status update form with valid data. | Lab In-charge submits the status update form. | Status is updated successfully. |
| TC-003 | Lab In-charge can submit reports offline | Req-10 | Positive | Lab In-charge is logged in. | Offline report submission form with valid data. | Lab In-charge submits the report offline. | Report is submitted successfully. |
| TC-004 | Patient can view prescription | Req-11 | Positive | Patient is logged in. | None | Patient navigates to their prescription page. | Prescription is displayed with details. |
| TC-005 | Patient can print invoice | Req-11 | Positive | Patient is logged in. | None | Patient prints the invoice. | Invoice is printed successfully. |
| TC-006 | Invalid status update attempt | Req-10 | Negative | Lab In-charge is logged in. | Status update form with invalid data. | Lab In-charge submits the status update form. | Error message is displayed. |
| TC-007 | Unauthorized access attempt | Req-10 | Negative | Unauthorized user attempts to access lab management features. | None | Unauthorized user attempts to access lab management features. | Access denied message is displayed. |
| TC-008 | Archiving inactive patient profiles | Req-12 | Positive | System is scheduled for quarterly archiving. | None | System automatically archives inactive patient profiles. | Inactive patient profiles are archived. |
| TC-009 | Archiving consultation requests | Req-12 | Positive | System is scheduled for quarterly archiving. | None | System automatically archives consultation requests older than 3 years. | Consultation requests older than 3 years are archived. |

```
